comment: Complex ring stereo fixtures -- Phase 153 wires complex_ring through the Tier-A injection at composer.py:1614-1635 (extension of Phase 152 benzene/heterocycle pattern). D-23 corpus-mined from benchmarks/{chebi_5000,pubchem_2000,opsin_selftest_500}.csv + .planning/phases/152-handler-level-stereo-injection/stereo_gap_post_commit_5.txt (3 carry-over rows). Distribution per RESEARCH Pattern 5: 2 bicyclo, 2 spiro, 2 ortho-fused-heterocycle, 1 bridged-fused, 1 ring-junction (steroid-class), 3 carry-overs. The 3 stereo_gap_post_commit_5.txt carry-over compounds (oxospiro[4.5]decane, pentahydroxy hexacyclic, pentacyclic terpene) are the gold-standard validation set per D-15 (>=2/3 must drop out of post-153 stereo_gap_trace). Per D-22, OPSIN round-trip is the correctness oracle; xfail with reason='opsin-cli-2.9.0-cannot-parse' for fixtures where the OPSIN parser limitation prevents structural round-trip (the always-run P-91 prefix gate still applies per BL-04 split-stage assertion).
